svg.title: Four-year FLF work plan with WP1 imaging
svg.desc: Four-year FLF work plan. WP1 imaging preparation in Year 1, fMRI and MEG acquisition in Years 2–3, and analysis/write-up in Year 4. PI and one postdoc, both FLF-funded at 100% for 48 months. Adapted only in the presentation folder; original ERC sources unchanged.
